column1: # UI string/template additions for round 6, harvested from LogOutput.log.
# Format: <harvest index> <TAB> S (exact string) | T (template, digit runs become '#') <TAB> translation
# '<LF>' becomes a real line break, mirroring the source text: the rendered strings for indices 009, 012,
# 015, 020, 024 and 036 contain real line breaks and 009 also ends with one. A literal backslash-n
# (as in some other harvested strings) is written as \n and stays literal.
# Indices refer to tools/sources/ui-round6-sources.txt (the human-readable listing of this harvest) and are
# resolved against tools/sources/ui-round6-harvest.json, which holds the exact key text. Freeze that file
# before translating: the client rewrites BepInEx\LogOutput.log on every launch, so the live log cannot
# reproduce the keys a round was authored against.
# Indices 002, 003 and 004 are already covered by the existing table and are therefore not repeated.
# Skill and role names reuse the wording already published in the static table, so the same Japanese
#   なめまわし = Lick-Down, エクスプロード = Explode, 援護射撃 = Supporting Fire,
#   致命の閃き = Fatal Flash, ディクライン・カヴァー = Decline Cover, 一時の休息 = A Moment's Rest,
#   物理アタッカー = Physical Attacker, サポート = Support, 後衛 = Rearguard, タンク = Tank,
#   採掘効率 = Mining Efficiency, メイズシフター = Maze Shifter, ニーナ／ジーナ・ミーシナ = Nina / Gina Mishina.
